definitions.gloss: large army; great host of troops
definitions.explanation: A very large military force. Used mainly in history, war stories, and news about past battles; also, loosely, a huge crowd of people descending on a place.

examples.japanese: {大軍|たいぐん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{攻|せ}めて→攻める：02123_semeru⟧きた。
examples.english: A great army came to attack.

examples.japanese: ⟦{敵|てき}→敵：03546_teki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大軍|たいぐん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{囲|かこ}まれた→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧。
examples.english: We were surrounded by a huge enemy army.

examples.japanese: {信長|のぶなが}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧⟦{兵|へい}→兵：29510_hei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{今川|いまがわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大軍|たいぐん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{破|やぶ}った→破る：02321_yaburu⟧。
examples.english: Nobunaga defeated the Imagawa's great army with only a few soldiers.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大軍|たいぐん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{率|ひき}いる→率いる：10879_hikiiru⟧: to lead a great army
- {大軍|たいぐん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{押|お}し{寄|よ}せる→押し寄せる：06733_oshiyoseru⟧: a huge army surges in
- ⟦{十万|じゅうまん}→十万：30469_juuman⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大軍|たいぐん}: an army of a hundred thousand
- ⟦{敵|てき}→敵：03546_teki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大軍|たいぐん}: a huge enemy force

WATCH OUT:
- ⟦{大群|たいぐん}→大群：21157_taigun⟧: large swarm, large herd — same reading, but used of animals and insects (⟦{鳥|とり}→鳥：00679_tori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大群|たいぐん}→大群：21157_taigun⟧, a huge flock of birds); {大軍|たいぐん} is for soldiers
